notes: B's national labour-law analysis was much deeper: the LOPDGDD 89 audio rule, the Art. 4(2) exemption, Art. 4(3) use conditions, and the multi-site/INL route. A was stronger only on AI Act timing, stating 2 December 2027 with its basis, but it hedged on the national lists, omitted the audio and exception points, and treated an internal 'current High' rating as triggering Art. 36.
